Signed-off-by: youjiali1995 <zlwgx1023@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29881

Problem Summary:

unistore needs to support read-through-lock to write test.

### What is changed and how it works?

get/batchGet/scan supports it. However, coprocessor in unistore is much different from TiKV -- unistore scans all locks in the range at first, while TiKV scans key by key and check lock. I can't find a suitable way to implement read-through-lock for coprocessor in unistore, so I just implement it get/batchGet/scan. 

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [-] Unit test

Side effects


Documentation


issue_context.title: unistore supports read-through-lock
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

unistore has to implement it as TiKV does https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/11238 to write tests.

review_comments: If the lock type is not `Put`, value will be nil, so we skip this key here.
The lock type is either `Put` or `Del` because only locks that can block read are in `LockPair`.
I mistakenly thought the `Del` record needs a `nil` return, LGTM.
